hook: UGC NET Dec 2026: you can still apply till *Oct 31*
hook_b: Missed the UGC NET form? 3 more days to apply
tldr: NTA has kept UGC NET December 2026 registration open till October 31 (NDTV). The regular fee window was October 28, 11:50 pm; PW lists Oct 29–31 as a late window with a ₹500 late fee. Exam: December 14–19, 87 subjects.

beats.what: UGC NET December 2026 applications on ugcnet.nta.nic.in now run till October 31, up from October 28.
beats.why: NET is the gate for Assistant Professor jobs, JRF and PhD admissions. One form, one shot till the June cycle.
beats.care: PG student or grad? Apply tonight (Oct 28) to dodge a possible ₹500 late fee. Check the final fee on the NTA site.

cards.body: Dates to save: regular window Oct 28 (11:50 pm) · late window Oct 29–31 · fix mistakes Nov 2–4 · exam Dec 14–19. Fees: ₹1,150 General, ₹600 EWS/OBC-NCL, ₹325 SC/ST/PwD/third gender, plus ₹500 if you apply late (per PW).

cards.caption: subjects in UGC NET Dec 2026
cards.body: The exam runs Dec 14 to 19. Correction window opens Nov 2, so you can fix typos after applying.

cards.q: When can you correct your UGC NET form?
cards.why: Nov 2 to Nov 4, up to 11:50 pm.

learn.t: JRF (Junior Research Fellowship): a top NET score that comes with a monthly fellowship for PhD research. Lower qualifying scores give Assistant Professor and/or PhD-admission eligibility.

watch: Late fee and final dates on ugcnet.nta.nic.in; correction window Nov 2–4.
